DashboardApps: From storage to collaboration, data collection, automation, and AI — each app is built for a different job. Use the graduation cap icon on an app card to take or replay its tour.
DashboardCreate: Choose a text document, spreadsheet, presentation, or PDF form, upload existing files, or start an AI chat. New documents are saved to {{files}}, ready whenever you need them.
DashboardDevTools: This is your developer hub: APIs, SDKs, plugins, webhooks, and more. Click into any card to learn more or get started.
DashboardIntegrations: Already using another platform? Choose a ready-to-use integration to bring editors and apps into the tools your team uses. Open a card for setup instructions.
DashboardOverview: This page is just one click away — open {{overview}} in the sidebar whenever you need it.
DashboardProfile: Here are your workspace name and profile details. Use the available actions to rename the workspace or manage your password. Open your Profile page for other personal settings.
